patch_list: Neutralizes Mereframe's install-integrity checks so patched (re-signed) builds start normally instead of showing the installation-refused screen. Required for any other patch here to be usable.

Neutralizes libunnamed_raw.so's five ARM64 self-integrity gates (BTI/PAC-safe) and wraps the session-opening plus every other native-calling bridge wrapper in a real JVM try/catch that fails open on integrity errors. Required together with…

DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - writes the full stack trace to Downloads/mereframe-crash-*.txt when the app crashes, for remote diagnosis. Off by default; enable when asked to produce a crash log. Chain-forwards to the original crash handler.

Unlocks all Mereframe Pro features locally across both the Kotlin entitlement resolver (Qu.k/m) and the native license/session verifier (Bf1c089 + libunnamed_raw.so), eliminating paywall popups and capture/editor SecurityException crashes.…
